notes.title: Update 1.1 is here!
notes.content:
New mechanics: coloured switches and locks.

Yellow locks: trigger ALL switches to open.
Green locks: trigger ANY switch to open.
Blue locks: trigger ONLY ONE switch to open.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686561/45b23ef61f1ce246911a1dc7f66fc5018e7e5226.png[/img]

30 EXTRA levels with switches and locks:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686561/e40238138ae40c430f277d4bcd8edf05cdba0dab.png[/img]

Updated Options menu with a dedicated Volume slider.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686561/20681b9f0bd58186ec48bb54c102934a804620c5.png[/img]

New progression system: now you can play any level in the row. Unlock the next row by beating all levels in the previous one.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42686561/efae629e089c247ad20d5d5755d7c8e1b2a4a24f.png[/img]

Minor changes:
[list]
[*] Added splash screen
[*] Added menu sounds
[*] New explosion animation
[*] Fixes some typos in localized text
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.4
notes.content:
[list]
[*] [b]Fast movement[/b] is now available. Some players complained that Ailin moves too slowly. This is especially noticeable in larger levels. A new option is introduced to alleviate these frustrations, allowing Ailin to move much faster. 
[*] Options menu layout is changed to accommodate the new option.
[*] [b]CRT shader[/b] is reconfigured to provide a clearer image. 
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.3: new hints
notes.content:
Update 1.0.3 is here, it includes one significant change:
[list]
[*] There are now subtle hints on some levels which show the order in which destination points should be filled.
[/list]
